name: view_m6_effects
description: M6's effects show what the simulation's records hold, as the rules track's simulation writes them (contract-m6.md §5, design 3.2 and 3.7): a Hive Hum hastens every tower in its reach, whoever built it, and those glow honey at their feet (not the hum, not a tower out of reach); the Toll Tower's real pulse (EV_PULSE) rings its bell out from its cell and the creeps it stuns circle stars while their records hold them stunned; a creep the Chime Post cracks shimmers bronze and its selection says 'cracked –2'; a Clay Hive's bees swarm over the creep its record's cloud_creep names, as wide as its cloud. The Clapper Tower's strike is a clap with nothing in flight, the Apiary's shot a bee, a Ringing Clapper's splash rings bronze. At every step the effects on screen are the records' (effects_off_records), and each goes when its record lets go: the glows when the hum is sold, the cloud when its creeps are gone.

steps.assert: ringing.form == 'ringing_clapper' and hive.form == 'clay_hive' and apiary.form == 'apiary' and toll.form == 'toll_tower' and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(12, 7)).form == 'hive_hum' and chime.form == 'chime_post'
apiary.rec.haste_pm == 150 and hive.rec.haste_pm == 150 and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(12, 7)).rec.haste_pm == 0 and toll.rec.haste_pm == 0 and ringing.rec.haste_pm == 0
steps.msg: the simulation hastens the towers in the hum's reach, whoever built them, not the hum itself

steps.assert: apiary.effects_shown().hum and hive.effects_shown().hum and not scene.tower_at(Vector2i(12, 7)).effects_shown().hum and not toll.effects_shown().hum and not ringing.effects_shown().hum and apiary._hum.is_visible_in_tree()
steps.msg: and those glow honey at their feet, the others not
the views show what the records hold
the simulation's pulse rings the Toll Tower's bell from its cell
a creep the pulse stunned circles stars while its record holds it stunned
a creep the Chime Post cracks shimmers bronze round its middle
its selection says it is cracked, by how much
the Clay Hive's bees swarm over the creep its cloud stings
as wide as its cloud reaches (0.9 tiles)
the Clapper Tower strikes with a clap, the Apiary's shot is a bee
the Ringing Clapper strikes with a clap too, and its splash rings bronze instead of bursting

steps.assert: apiary.rec.haste_pm == 0 and not apiary.effects_shown().hum and not hive.effects_shown().hum
steps.msg: the glows go when the hum is sold
the cloud goes with its creeps
